record.question: Pepsico Inc had sued few Indian farmers as they illegally cultivated a Potato variety known as:
record.explanation: Answer C: FC5. The 2019 PepsiCo cases concerned the FC5 potato variety. The source options are DC5, GC5, FC5 and HC5, so the matching answer is option (c). Reference: https://www.pepsico.com/news/press-release/pepsico-india-withdraws-lawsuits-against-farmers04222019. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
